name: project-trust-audit
description: Unofficial, read-only skill for the 2026 eMudhra weak intermediate CA key incident: checks a repository's CA bundles, TLS-bypass settings and dependency versions without running project code.

interface.shortDescription: Audit repo for eMudhra CA keys
interface.longDescription: Unofficial community skill, not affiliated with eMudhra. Read-only check of a repository's vendored CA bundles against the compromised eMudhra intermediate SPKI hashes, plus TLS-verification bypasses, custom CA overrides and lockfile versions, using only OS-standard commands and never running project code. Reports evidence, confidence and coverage gaps; never changes anything or sends data.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository for the eMudhra CA incident and TLS verification bypasses
Find code or config in this repository that disables TLS certificate verification
